findings.summary: Selected CLK_ADC_CTRL as one idempotent clock-manager write/readback/restore target.
Avoided critical SYS/SLOW_SYS clocks, UART clock, GPCLK output-enable, GPIO14/GPIO16, interrupt, PCIe/MSI-X/MIP, GIC, and reset-controller paths.
Required pre-read raw value writes only, so partial failure after the first write leaves the register at the pre-read value.
Non-idempotent clock changes, reset writes, GPIO ownership, event generation, and interrupt delivery require later source contracts.
The accepted contract is a narrow write-path proof, not broad RP1 clock/reset ownership.
